summary: Framework sync must target a repository via --repo and paginate GitHub's path-scoped list endpoints; commits key on sha.
reason: GitHub collaboration resources live under /repos/{owner}/{repo}/... and cannot be enumerated as a flat catalog. A regen that restores empty defaultSyncResources or disables pagination would make `sync` a no-op and truncate collections after the first page.
validated_outcome: defaultSyncResources is non-empty; resourceSupportsPagination is true for those resources; fillGitHubSyncRepoPath substitutes owner/repo; go test ./internal/cli/... passes.
